::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's first vertically integrated SiC production chain (first line lit June 2021) and the country's largest self-contained SiC IDM platform, at ¥16 billion planned; by the May 2026 shareholders meeting the 6-inch line was running 16,000 wafers/month at ~85% yield with high utilization, and the in-house 8-inch SiC chip line — line-out August 2025, built in under a year — was reported fully activated.
:::

**Chinese name:** 湖南三安半导体有限责任公司 (Húnán Sān'ān Bàndǎotǐ)

## What does this facility make?

6/8-inch SiC MOSFET/SBD devices and modules for EVs, PV and storage (customers include Sungrow and major OEMs), plus GaN-on-Si power wafers.

## Why does it matter?

Parent Sanan Optoelectronics posted its first annual loss for 2025 with SiC depreciation as a named drag while pushing for SiC profitability in 2026 — the clearest single-company view of China's painful SiC cost-down race. Governance flag: GM Lin Kechuang (also chairman of the ST JV 安意法) was reported detained May 2026 and released around October 2026.

## Project Timeline

- **Jun 2021** — First SiC line lit — billed as China's first vertically integrated SiC chain (plan 30,000 6-inch wafers/month)
- **Nov 2022** — ¥3.8 billion multi-year supply agreement with an EV OEM (行家说 coverage)
- **Aug 2025** — Own 8-inch SiC chip line announced line-out (通线)
- **May 2026** — Annual meeting: 6-inch at 16,000 wafers/month, 8-inch line fully activated; SiC profitability targeted for 2026
